title: Reproduction Test Generation for Java SWE Issues
year_venue: 2026 arXiv preprint, version 2 dated 2026-05-07; manuscript CC BY 4.0
datasets: TDD-Bench-Java: 250 Java issue-reproduction tasks across 13 repositories, derived from Java samples in Multi-SWE-bench and SWE-PolyBench
Proprietary IBM Java dataset: 150 issues, not public
SWT-Bench/TDD-Bench-Verified are related Python benchmarks; Defects4J only related work
license: Apache-2.0 public benchmark/evaluator repository; CC BY 4.0 article; upstream repositories retain their own licenses
input_setting: Issue description + pre-fix Java repository; hide the code fix at generation time; score test patches on pre-fix/fixed versions with fail-to-pass
concept_hook: Issue-to-test behavioral oracle, directly checked by a pre-fix fail / post-fix pass
limitation: Paper generator code is proprietary; exact Claude/GPT revisions are not pinned; no causal root-cause labels; no Defects4J/BugsInPy/SWT-Bench experiment
